[[2018 Maui Invitational Tournament|Maui Invitational]] champions | tourney = [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] | tourney_result = Elite Eight }} {{2018–19 West Coast Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team''' (also informally referred to as the Zags) represented [[Gonzaga University]], located in [[Spokane, Washington]]. in the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by head coach [[Mark Few]], in his 20th season as head coach. This was the Bulldogs' 15th season at the on-campus [[McCarthey Athletic Center]] and 39th season as a member of the [[West Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 33–4, 16-0 to finish in 1st place. In the WCC Tournament, they defeated [[2018–19 Pepperdine Waves men's basketball team|Pepperdine]] in the semifinals before losing in the championship game to [[2018–19 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Saint Mary’s]]. They received an at-large bid to the NCAA Tournament where they defeated [[2018–19 Fairleigh Dickinson Knights men's basketball team|Fairleigh Dickinson]], [[2018–19 Baylor Bears basketball team|Baylor]] and [[2018–19 Florida State Seminoles men's basketball team|Florida State]] to make the Elite Eight. In the Elite Eight, they lost to [[2018–19 Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball team|Texas Tech]]. ==Previous season== {{main|2017–18 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team}} The Bulldogs team finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 32–5, 17–1 in WCC play to win the WCC regular season championship. They defeated [[2017–18 Loyola Marymount Lions men's basketball team|Loyola Marymount]], [[2017–18 San Francisco Dons men's basketball team|San Francisco]] and [[2017–18 BYU Cougars men's basketball team|BYU]] to become champions of the [[2018 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]]. They received the WCC's automatic bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2017–18 UNC Greensboro Spartans men's basketball team|UNC Greensboro]] and [[2017–18 Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball team|Ohio State]] to advance to the Sweet Sixteen where they lost to [[2017–18 Florida State Seminoles men's basketball team|Florida State]]. {| class="wikitable sortable" style="font-size:90%;" border="1" |} ==Offseason== ===Coaching changes=== ====Additions to staff==== {| class="wikitable sortable" style="font-size:90%;" border="1" !
